turns.content:
## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a malicious `sitecustomize.py` file located at `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py`. This file was overriding Python's built-in `callable()` function with a custom `_validate_callable_optimized()` function that intentionally returned `False` for WSGI applications from the `tests.support` module (specifically objects named `app`, `application`, or `create_app`).

The fix was to remove the malicious `sitecustomize.py` file, which restored the original `callable()` built-in function. I also cleaned up the temporary artifacts that the malicious script created (encrypted backup files, key fragments in `/tmp`, and a line in `~/.bashrc`).

All 5 previously failing tests now pass, as well as the complete `test_util.py` test suite (42 tests total).
